title: The Generalized Étale-Homotopy Section Conjecture
exact_target: Determine the classes of varieties $X/k$ for which the canonical map $X(k)\to\Gamma^{\mathrm{et}}(X/k)$ is a bijection, where $\Gamma^{\mathrm{et}}(X/k)$ is the set of homotopy classes of sections of the étale-homotopy fibration $\Pi^{\mathrm{et}}(X)\to\Pi^{\mathrm{et}}(k)$.
